data.title: Hires, information sector (BLS JOLTS)
data.summary: Gross hires in the US information sector fell from 1,270,000 in 2022 to 903,000 in 2025, a decline of 367,000 or 28.9%. The measure counts hiring flows, not layoff announcements.
data.citation: US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey, series JTU510000000000000HIL (Hires, information, total US, not seasonally adjusted).
